BiblicalUsage: This is a wall, and Ezekiel uses it for the false prophets' work: one builds up a wall and others daub it with untempered mortar, while they say Peace and there is no peace. The wall looks finished and holds nothing.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a wall daubed with lies will fall when the storm comes, and God is the one who brings the storm.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
